svg.text: Private residence — rear courtyard (site address to be inserted)
1. Do not scale from this drawing. Use figured dimensions only.
2. All dimensions in millimetres; levels in metres relative to internal FFL
±0.000 (datum to be tied to site survey).
3. Contractor to verify all dimensions, levels & existing structure on site
4. Read with all other architectural, structural & services drawings and the
5. Structural members are preliminary: final design, connections &
calculations by a licensed structural engineer to local code before
6. Report any discrepancy to the designer before proceeding.
CONSTRUCTION ISSUE — subject to site survey & local engineer sign-off
Measured + level survey; structural survey of annex (slab, ring beam, pier); utility scan; engineer confirms S1 or S2; shop drawings approved.
Steel (2–3 wk), D01/D02 (4–6 wk), joinery D03/G01 (3–4 wk), pavers (1–2 wk), plants.
Protect façade/doors/AC; strip paving & topsoil to formation; set TBM.
Dig footings, kerb trench, gully & pipe trenches; lay Ø110 drains, IC1, SA1.
Blinding; pads F1/F2 with cast-in RWP bend; kerb strip footing; HD bolts by template.
Pedestals; kerb upstand (MJ @ 4.2 m); cure 7 days.
Ledger anchors (pull-test 3 no.); posts plumb & grout; beams, joists; bolts torqued.
Firrings, ply deck, gutter, outlet, TPO, flashings; overflow.
LED/downlight cabling in void, conduit through façade, drivers in utility; irrigation header sleeve.
Battens, insect fleece, LED profiles, slats; fascia/capping; post cladding.
Tanking, drainage sheet, gravel, geotextile, topsoil; coping; render & paint.
Sub-base, slot drain, gullies, bedding, pavers to colour map, jointing, vibrate.
Install D01, D02 (motor), D03, G01 screen & gate.
Wires, plants, drip lines, controller, mulch, uplights aimed.
Connect fittings, test & certify, program controls; snag; clean.

Indicative site duration ≈ 6–7 weeks after a 4–6 week procurement period (doors are the long lead). Stages 9–14 overlap where trades allow. Weather windows: membrane & concrete not below +5 °C or in rain.

Working at height (canopy at +3.0 m): mobile towers / scaffold with guard-rails, no work from ladders on deck. Lifting: beams ≤ 140 kg (B2 S1 ≈ 380 kg — use hoist / 2-man lift with lifting aid). Excavations > 1.2 m none planned. Silica dust: wet-cut pavers & coping. Electrical: isolate & lock-off; RCD tools.
As-built drawings, steel & galvanising certificates, membrane warranty, electrical certificate, door/motor manuals, irrigation programme, plant list & maintenance schedule (A-001 §15).
